name: lane_layer1_plunge
description: Ball on layer 1 at the serve position (297,346), plunger held 8 frames then released: EP6's lane guard (cs:0AD5..0AEA) tests active, x >= 0x122 and y >= 0x154 but not the level byte, so the plunger charges on layer 1 too (charge up to 96, lowest vy -60); EP1/EP7/EP9 test ball_layer[0] == 0 first.
